description:
Create a new verification request to ask another user to share verified assets.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), or sign in with start_login — a session opens this tool — then call this tool again.

action_context.description: Additional context about why assets are needed

assets.description: Asset type identifiers to request (e.g. email, phone, identity)

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for request status updates

partial_ok.description: Whether partial asset sharing is acceptable (default: false)

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect the subject after completing the request

validity_requirement.description: Required validity level for shared assets

name: create_user_request
